title: GPA Descent
body:
Consider the following non-linear model with two parameters:
$$f_{	heta}(x)=	heta_{0}\cdot{0}.5+	heta_{0}\cdot	heta_{1}\cdot{x}_1+\sin(	heta_1)\cdot{x}_2$$

For some nonsensical reason, we decide to use the residuals of our model as the loss function. That is, the loss for a single observation is
$$L(	heta)=y_i-f_{	heta}(x_i)$$

We want to use gradient descent to determine the optimal model parameters, $$\hat{	heta}_0$$ and $$\hat{	heta}_1.$$
